appearance.short_description: An old fisherman with a salt-crusted beard sits at the edge of the docks, boots dangling over the water beside a narrow skiff.
on_enter_room_text: An old fisherman stares out over the water, unmoving despite the noise of the docks.

greeting.say: You’ve got the look of someone who doesn’t turn back easy.
If you’re just here to stare, plenty of sea for that.

text.say: Found it rowing the coast. Low mouth. Water pooling inside. Didn’t feel like a place meant for breathing folk.
Call them what you like. Cold air where there shouldn’t be. Sounds that stop when you listen. I won’t set foot past the entrance.

text.emote: glances at the skiff, then back at you
text.say: I can row you there. I won’t go inside. And I won’t do it for someone who’s likely to panic halfway.

text.emote: studies you for a long moment
text.say: Words are cheap. Convince me you won’t freeze up when the water turns quiet.

on_success.say: Fine. Grab your gear. I’ll put you ashore and wait. Shout if you want back.

on_fail.say: No. I’ve pulled too many fools out of the water already.
